description.en:
H1 is Unitree's first full-size general-purpose humanoid platform. Its development emphasizes dynamic bipedal movement, using high-output joints and coordinated control to support walking, running and balance experiments. Lidar and depth-camera inputs provide spatial information for perception and navigation development.

The original H1 configuration differs from the later H1-2, particularly in leg and arm articulation. Published speed figures also distinguish demonstrated performance from potential hardware capability. H1 serves as a platform for research and application development, with task behavior determined by the installed sensing, software and end effectors rather than the motion hardware alone.
